description: Batch of landed changes waiting for the next full CI run. Append with `python3 tools/ci_pending.py add ...`; tools/ci.sh archives this file to runs/ci/<run-id>/pending.json and resets it at the start of every run. See docs/CI-WORKFLOW.md.

policy.full_gate: tools/run-cpu-intensive-task.sh --ci, owned by the CI fixer; do not run the full gate after every edit
policy.record: one entry per landed change/batch: files, likely gates, reproduction command and expected result
policy.wipe: archived and reset by tools/ci.sh at run start

entries.head: c49d4b6b
entries.summary: Add F0 refactor checks (api_surface, move_check) and the committed baseline
entries.expected: empty diff (1890 lines); move_check.py self-compare prints only-in-old 0 and exits 0; both scripts executable
entries.risk: Python-only + generated baseline: no Rust, scene, asset or golden change, so fmt/clippy/cargo-check are unaffected. docs/PLANS/baseline/api_surface.txt pins the gdext API, so any later legitimate API addition must regenerate it (C01) or the RULES §6 diff fails.

entries.head: 8bfa2c7b
entries.summary: Add shared gdutil modules, kit factories and MindDialog refresh plumbing
entries.repro: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/clintonnguyen/g/code_examples/Mindustry-Godot/.git/mindustry-wave-target tools/run-cpu-intensive-task.sh --cargo-test -p mind-gdext --lib && python3 tools/refactor/api_surface.py | diff docs/PLANS/baseline/api_surface.txt -
entries.expected: 435/435 mind-gdext lib tests pass; clippy -D warnings clean; api-surface diff empty
entries.risk: Additive only (no call site changed), but every gdutil body is copied from a dialog-local helper: a W2 adoption must diff the helper against its copy first, or the fallback order drifts. serde was added to mind-gdext (Cargo.lock entry must stay in sync).

entries.head: 8bfa2c7b
entries.summary: Add the dialog group scaffold (14 groups, 85 stub leaves) and dialogs/common; wire controller_for groups-first
entries.repro: cargo test -p mind-gdext --lib dialogs, then godot4 --headless --path client res://scenes/tools/dialog_sweep_check.tscn
entries.expected: 82 passed, 0 failed (includes every_manifest_id_resolves_exactly_once over all 59 ids); dialog_sweep_check reports failed=0
entries.risk: controller_for order; a stub leaf shadowing an id. Every group dispatch returns None today, so the old modules still answer every id and the order cannot change behaviour. The risk lands when the W1 packages fill leaves: a leaf that returns Some for an id the batch file still answers makes every_manifest_id_resolves_exactly_once fail (that is the intended alarm). No .tscn, manifest or golden touched, so Godot import/sweep should be unchanged.

entries.head: 8bfa2c7b
entries.summary: Add mind-core sim/game test-support fixture modules for W2 adoption
entries.repro: cargo test -p mind-core --lib sim::test_support && cargo test -p mind-core --lib game::test_support
entries.expected: 2 self-tests pass (helper and original fixture checksums equal); game module compiles; test inventory grows only by the two self-tests
entries.risk: Test-only modules: no sim behavior change, so scenario checksums/goldens cannot drift. clippy -D warnings fails if the module-level dead_code allow is removed before W2 adopts the helpers; each self-test builds two Sims and adds ~0.1s
